## Purpose

Cross-cutting configuration, identity, security, and entitlement primitives with no knowledge of
a specific workflow: `Settings` ([config.py](../../backend/app/core/config.py)); Cognito JWKS verification and provider adapters
([cognito.py](../../backend/app/core/cognito.py)); the shared credential-to-principal resolver ([identity.py](../../backend/app/core/identity.py)); JIT local-user
provisioning ([provisioning.py](../../backend/app/core/provisioning.py)); ordered Cognito admin lifecycle operations
([cognito_admin.py](../../backend/app/core/cognito_admin.py)); explicit dependent cleanup ([user_deletion.py](../../backend/app/core/user_deletion.py));
FastAPI dependencies ([dependencies.py](../../backend/app/core/dependencies.py)); at-rest encryption ([crypto.py](../../backend/app/core/crypto.py)); and
pipeline entitlement policy ([entitlements.py](../../backend/app/core/entitlements.py)).

**Nearly every other backend module depends on it transitively** â€” identity and authorization
at protected ingress, and `settings` everywhere from model selection to shutdown timing.

## Shape

- [config.py](../../backend/app/core/config.py) â€” `Settings(BaseSettings)` (pydantic-settings), a single `settings` module-level
  instance read everywhere. Fields fall into bands: LLM provider selection (Anthropic direct /
  Bedrock IAM / Bedrock bearer-token / Mistral fallback), output/token/timeout ceilings
  (`MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`, `LLM_CALL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`), SSE transport tuning
  (`SSE_KEEPALIVE_PING_SECONDS`, `SSE_SUBSCRIBER_QUEUE_MAXSIZE`), graceful-shutdown budgets
  (`SHUTDOWN_CONCIERGE_DRAIN_SECONDS`, `SHUTDOWN_STOP_RUNS`), sandbox/runtime knobs
  (`RUNS_ROOT`, `AGENT_RECURSION_LIMIT`, `RUN_DIR_TTL_HOURS`), and auth/db basics
  (`SECRET_KEY`, `DATABASE_URL`, `CORS_ORIGINS`).

  Two `@model_validator` hooks run at construction: `_default_shutdown_stop_runs_from_env`
  (env-differentiated default, only when unset) and `_validate_secret_key` (refuses to boot on
  a default/weak `SECRET_KEY` outside `ENV=development`, raising `SecretKeyMisconfigured`).
  `redact_db_url()` strips the inline Postgres password before any boot-banner logging.
- [cognito.py](../../backend/app/core/cognito.py) â€” Cognito pool/JWKS validation and provider calls; accepts only valid RS256
  access tokens for the configured issuer, client, and token use. [identity.py](../../backend/app/core/identity.py) is the
  sole HTTP/transport credential resolver: it creates a `Principal`, maps it through
  `users.cognito_sub`, JIT-provisions an absent mapping only after validation, and derives
  effective tier/admin from `cognito:groups` rather than the local projection.
- [security.py](../../backend/app/core/security.py) retains provider-independent local security helpers, including the
  `jti` revocation lookup. [dependencies.py](../../backend/app/core/dependencies.py) composes those checks with the shared
  resolver and rejects tokens predating `max(password_changed_at, tokens_valid_from)`;
  its refresh-only dependency may accept a just-expired otherwise-valid bearer within the
  configured grace period. `get_user_for_logout` remains deliberately idempotent.
- [provisioning.py](../../backend/app/core/provisioning.py), [cognito_admin.py](../../backend/app/core/cognito_admin.py), and [user_deletion.py](../../backend/app/core/user_deletion.py)
  isolate provider and persistence side effects from route handlers: projection refresh/JIT
  creation, ordered invitation/group/disable/delete operations, and dependent-row deletion.
- [crypto.py](../../backend/app/core/crypto.py) encrypts stored provider refresh tokens and integration secrets with an
  HKDF-derived key from `settings.SECRET_KEY`, rather than exposing either plaintext at rest.
- [entitlements.py](../../backend/app/core/entitlements.py) â€” `TIER_PIPELINES` (which pipeline types each tier â€” basic/hexaware/pro/
  enterprise â€” may run), `UPGRADE_PATH`, and `can_run_pipeline(user_tier, pipeline_type)`.

## Why this shape

**Fail-closed by construction**: a missing/default `SECRET_KEY` still refuses to boot outside
development, and a non-development Cognito deployment also requires a coherent pool/client
configuration before it serves traffic. Provider access tokens are verified against the configured
Cognito issuer and JWKS; application-held refresh and integration credentials are encrypted with
a key *derived from* (not equal to) `SECRET_KEY`.

[dependencies.py](../../backend/app/core/dependencies.py) splits "strict" (`get_current_user`) from "idempotent-friendly"
(`get_user_for_logout`) rather than parameterizing one function, keeping each call site's
revocation semantics explicit instead of behind a flag.

[config.py](../../backend/app/core/config.py) centralizes every environment-differentiated runtime knob (shutdown budgets, SSE
tuning, sandbox TTLs) as a single `Settings` object rather than scattering `os.getenv()` calls
through the codebase, so `extra = "ignore"` is required (production's secrets-loader pours
every SSM key into the env, and boto3 reads its own `AWS_*` vars) but every value this app
actually reads is declared and typed.

This module deliberately excludes persistence models (delegated to `[MOD-backend-app-models](MOD-backend-app-models.md)`)
and route handlers (`[MOD-backend-app-api](MOD-backend-app-api.md)`) â€” it is pure cross-cutting policy.
